get.description: Returns one UTC summary scoped to the current workspace. Metric permissions: nextKeyEvent requires economic-calendar:read, watchlist:read, asset:read; recentEvents requires event:read, watchlist:read, asset:read; marketEvents24h requires event:read, watchlist:read, asset:read; activeNarratives requires narrative:read, watchlist:read, asset:read; marketNarratives requires narrative:read, watchlist:read, asset:read; latestNews6h requires news-article:read; assetsInFocus requires watchlist:read, asset:read, and at least one of event:read or narrative:read. Event window [asOf - 24h, asOf), Market Narratives window [asOf - 7d, asOf), and Narrative window [asOf - 7d, asOf) are UTC half-open windows. The returned assetsInFocus.items order is authoritative: Event, Narrative EMERGING, WEAKENING, ACTIVE; then primary relation, observedAt DESC, confidence DESC NULLS LAST, source ID DESC, asset ID ASC. The returned marketNarratives.items order is authoritative: status EMERGING, WEAKENING, ACTIVE; canonical primary watchlist boost; lastUpdatedAt DESC, confidence DESC NULLS LAST, narrative ID DESC. Market Narratives uses NARRATIVE_READ_REQUIRED, WATCHLIST_READ_REQUIRED, ASSET_READ_REQUIRED, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, or SUMMARY_UNAVAILABLE when applicable. The metric has no request parameters; ASSETS_IN_FOCUS_READ_REQUIRED is returned when neither source permission is available.
